components.name: table
components.notes: Local table.tsx structurally mirrors the official shadcn/ui Table primitive (semantic elements Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableHead, TableRow, TableCell, TableCaption). It is intentionally simplified: no cn() utility, no class-variance-authority (cva), no className prop, renders children directly. The upstream Table wraps <table> in an outer <div> container; this intentional wrapper is not flagged as an incompatibility. Automated structural comparison verifies exported component names and rendered semantic HTML elements match upstream. Local modifications are detected by comparing the current local shim against its pinned local baseline (scripts/ci/shadcn-compatibility-baselines/table.tsx), not against the upstream source, because the local shim is intentionally not an exact upstream copy.

components.name: button
components.notes: Local button.tsx is a minimal role-equivalent shim: a <button> element forwarding ButtonHTMLAttributes with variant/size/asChild props. It is not a verified upstream copy — it omits cn(), cva, slot-based styling, and Radix UI primitives used by the official shadcn/ui Button. Source diff is not meaningful; changes to upstream require manual compatibility review.
